# Abdullah Hussain (abdullahanxie)

> Abdullah Hussain, known online as abdullahanxie, is an electrical engineering graduate from Rawalpindi, Pakistan. He is an AI engineer and researcher at Rare Sense Inc, co-author of the Nova3D paper on code-native 3D generation, and a filmmaker, documentary video editor, 3D artist, sound designer and athlete.

## Who he is
- Name: Abdullah Hussain. Handle: abdullahanxie (also "Abdullah Anxie").
- Based in Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan.
- Electrical engineering graduate.
- AI engineer and researcher at Rare Sense Inc (Nova3D and FormaNova).
- Filmmaker, documentary video editor, 3D artist (Blender) and sound designer for YouTube channels and brands worldwide.
- Athlete: running, football, horse riding, calisthenics and high-altitude trekking.

## Engineering and AI
- Co-author, "Nova3D: Code-Native Generation of Programmable 3D Assets" (Nimra Noor, Muhammad Bilal, Abdullah Hussain, Hassan Baig), arXiv 2607.22738, July 2026: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22738
- Nova3D: text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation that writes executable Blender code, producing editable, part-aware 3D assets with named parts and joints. Site: https://nova3d.xyz/ · Open-source client (700+ GitHub stars): https://github.com/RareSense/Nova3D
- FormaNova CAD Studio (Rare Sense's AI jewelry platform): with Nimra Noor he built one of the first pipelines that turns a reference image or text description into editable, native Rhino CAD (.3dm). https://formanova.ai/ · Article: https://abdullahanxie.github.io/procedural-rhino-jewelry/
- AI automation pipelines for the fashion brands J., Sitara and Kollective Moda (garment automation).
- Trains, deploys and automates AI systems end to end: datasets, model training (e.g. vision transformers), inference and production pipelines.
- Robotics: a 39-joint humanoid robot design with real actuators, and a quadruped robot dog simulated in MuJoCo inside Nova3D-generated digital twins.

## Film and art
- Faceless YouTube documentaries and edits: business stories, true crime, history and science, with motion graphics, Blender 3D scenes and original sound design.
- Films include "10 Mistakes That Cost More Than Anyone Imagined" (https://youtu.be/VIwarqevgpk) and "The Race to Build AI Nobody Can Stop" (https://youtu.be/6RON4CrBHWE).
- Has edited for channels and brands in the US, UK, Europe and Asia.
